initialize.instructions: Operate durable Limina projects at the mission boundary. Review work and knowledge, steer strategy, provide project variables, and manage project lifecycle. Limina owns provider sessions, threads, subagents, workspaces, and execution recovery. Never ask the user to manage those internals. Secret values must be configured through the trusted Limina CLI or REST API, not through model-visible MCP arguments.

tools.name: limina_list_projects
tools.description: List Limina projects visible to this team instance.

tools.name: limina_get_project_status
tools.description: Get a project's mission, state, next step, blocker, and knowledge counts.

tools.name: limina_create_project
tools.description:
Create a durable project; execution begins only after a start action.

Actor is the teammate steering the project. Supply a stable idempotency_key
if the client may retry the request.

tools.name: limina_manage_project
tools.description: Start, pause, resume, stop, or archive a Limina-managed project.

tools.name: limina_steer_project
tools.description: Give durable feedback or direction to a project, including active work.

tools.name: limina_review_project
tools.description: Review accepted knowledge, active evidence, resources, and recent activity.

tools.name: limina_get_knowledge
tools.description: Read one hypothesis, experiment, or finding by its durable artifact ID.

tools.name: limina_list_activity
tools.description: Read ordered durable activity after a cursor; use the returned cursor next time.

tools.name: limina_set_project_variable
tools.description: Set visible project configuration or a resource reference; never use for secrets.

tools.name: limina_list_project_resources
tools.description: List project variables and redacted secret metadata.

tools.name: limina_remove_project_resource
tools.description: Revoke a project variable or secret without exposing its value.

tools.name: limina_preflight_project
tools.description: Check whether a project draft has the mission and runtime prerequisites to start.

tools.name: limina_query_knowledge
tools.description: Search and filter the paginated project knowledge base.

tools.name: limina_get_knowledge_graph
tools.description: Read knowledge nodes and both evidence-chain and explicit relations.

tools.name: limina_list_guidance
tools.description: Review durable feedback with delivery and acknowledgement state.

tools.name: limina_list_runtime_runs
tools.description: Inspect managed runtime turns, timing, tool counts, failures, and usage.

tools.name: limina_get_project_analytics
tools.description: Aggregate run, knowledge, and human-guidance metrics for a project.

tools.name: limina_register_project_source
tools.description: Register a URL or connector for the managed runtime to consume.

tools.name: limina_list_project_members
tools.description: List project owners, editors, and viewers.

tools.name: limina_set_project_member
tools.description: Add a teammate or change their project role; project ownership is required.
